title: Section 7216 Outsourcing Consent and Vendor Security Tracker
shortDescription: Track client consent, service providers, security evidence, expiry dates, and release controls for outsourced tax work.
about:
An editable control tracker for tax-return preparers working with external providers. Record consent status and vendor evidence, then use the Go or No-Go field as a release control.

Review current IRS guidance and professional advice before relying on the workbook for a specific client or disclosure.
excerpt: Free Excel Section 7216 tracker with client consent, vendor-security evidence, expiry dates, and release-control fields.
